- **Story:** As Riley, I want the read and modify tasks (004, 005, 007, 008) scored by their executed outcomes in the Phrase arm, so that changing existing Phrase code is measured at the same level as changing existing C#.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given tasks 004, 005, 007 and 008 and a fake model whose recorded reply is a correct Phrase module, When the Phrase arm runs them, Then each row has proof level specs-passed and passes; a wrong reply fails naming the failing outcome
  2. Given a read or modify task, When its prompt is assembled, Then the starting Phrase code is inlined and the row records kind and existing_code_tokens like the C# arm (a test compares the two arms' field names)
  3. Given the starting code of each of the four tasks, When it is compiled with the C# adapter, Then it compiles and its own specs pass, so a model failing the task is failing the task and not the emitter (the check names any start fixture the emitter rejects, and the emitter gap is fixed test-first in this card)

## Context

- Same-level rule (Decider D37): Phrase and plain C# rows are compared only at the specs-passed proof level. The Phrase arm compiles the model's Phrase module with the C# adapter (Phrase.Adapters.CSharp), builds the generated projects, and runs the task's outcome cases against the generated phrase methods by reflection, exactly as tools/Phrase.BenchCs runs them against model code, plus the model's own generated specs must pass.
- The single source of a task's outcome cases is the C# twin's outcomes.json under bench/csharp-baseline/tasks/<id>/; the Phrase task folder gets a copy (a test asserts the two files are byte-identical so they cannot drift). The model only writes Phrase, so no row can be green by editing generated C#: the row records patched false by construction.
- Fixed head-to-head development tasks: 001, 002, 004, 005, 007, 008, 010, 011 (the eight with C# twins). Tasks 003, 006, 009 and 012 stay Phrase-only and are not compared. Fix tasks 010 and 011 keep their BROKEN start fixtures (PH330 on the phrase trigger; the Text/Int mismatch): only the reference solution compiles.
- Safety rules apply in full. Existing result rows keep their proof level; old parse-resolve rows are never mixed with specs-passed rows. Tests use fake model commands (no real model); a correct recorded reply passes and a wrong reply fails naming the failing outcome.
